mustHold: The tradeoff is laid out truthfully: Phase 1 (Towers A and B) is ready with OC received, 0% GST and immediate possession; Phase 2 (Towers C and D) is under construction with 5% GST, no OC yet and RERA-declared possession Q4-2028.

The couple is not pushed into a Phase 2 visit or token while they weigh ready vs under construction; the close is a truthful warm log.
